responsibility: Implements source-location and file-inclusion built-in macros such as `line!`, `column!`, `file!`, `module_path!`, `stringify!`, `include!`, `include_str!`, and `include_bytes!`. It computes expansion-site metadata, resolves and loads referenced files, reparses included source as expressions or items when needed, and emits diagnostics and lints for malformed or incomplete inclusions.
